description: Implementation of UCI scheduler logic for 5G NR, managing resource allocation for SR and CSI reports, including adding, removing, and scheduling UCI resources for UEs within a cellular network.

classes.name: uci_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Class implementing the UCI scheduling logic, managing resource allocation, UE registration, and scheduling for UCI reports.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Performs scheduling for a specific slot, allocating UCI opportunities.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Clears internal data structures to stop scheduling.

methods.name: add_resource
methods.description: Adds a resource (SR or CSI) for a UE at specified offset and period.

methods.name: rem_resource
methods.description: Removes a resource (SR or CSI) for a UE at specified offset and period.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Registers a new UE for UCI scheduling.

methods.name: add_ue_to_grid
methods.description: Adds UE's UCI resources to the scheduling grid.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures a UE's UCI resources based on new and old configurations.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE's UCI resources from the grid.

methods.name: get_ue_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a UE given its RNTI.

methods.name: schedule_slot_ucis
methods.description: Schedules UCI opportunities for a specific slot.

methods.name: schedule_updated_ues_ucis
methods.description: Schedules UCI for UEs with recent configuration updates.
